summary.en: Supplies sunlight to the solar system.
summary.zh: 为太阳系提供阳光。

detail.en:
The Sun is a star. Nuclear fusion in its hot plasma core releases energy. It has no solid surface. Its gravity holds the solar system together. [S3]

The physical reference radius is rounded to 700,000 km. This teaching sphere is enlarged in overview; its warm tone identifies a light source. Surface shading on other spheres only reveals their shape, not a day/night calculation. [S37]
detail.zh:
太阳是恒星。高温等离子体核心中的核聚变释放能量；它没有固体表面。太阳的引力维系着太阳系。[S3]

物理输入把半径粗略取作700,000千米。总览放大了这个教学球体；暖色用于辨认光源。其他球体的表面明暗只帮助看清形状，不计算昼夜。[S37]

summary.en: Orbits the Sun as a rocky planet.
summary.zh: 作为类地行星绕太阳公转。

detail.en:
Mercury is a rocky planet. Mean radius 2439.4 km; the displayed diameter is twice that. Its sidereal orbital period is 0.240847 Julian years. [S4,S5]

The reference semimajor axis is 0.387099 AU. This is a fitted reference value, not today's Sun distance. The model uses it as a circular radius with uniform angular motion; real orbits are ellipses. All starting phases are a teaching alignment. [S6,S26,S37]
detail.zh:
水星是类地行星。平均半径为2439.4千米；直径是半径的两倍。恒星公转周期为0.240847儒略年。[S4,S5]

参考半长轴为0.387099天文单位；这是拟合参考值，不是今天到太阳的距离。模型把它用作匀角速圆轨道的半径，真实轨道是椭圆。起始位置是教学排列。[S6,S26,S37]

detail.en:

The reference semimajor axis is 1 AU. This is a fitted reference value, not today's Sun distance. The model uses it as a circular radius with uniform angular motion; real orbits are ellipses. All starting phases are a teaching alignment. [S6,S26,S37]

参考半长轴为1天文单位；这是拟合参考值，不是今天到太阳的距离。模型把它用作匀角速圆轨道的半径，真实轨道是椭圆。起始位置是教学排列。 地球轨道参数采用地月质心的代理值。[S6,S26,S37]

The reference semimajor axis is 19.1892 AU. This is a fitted reference value, not today's Sun distance. The model uses it as a circular radius with uniform angular motion; real orbits are ellipses. All starting phases are a teaching alignment. [S6,S26,S37]

summary.zh: 作为冰巨行星绕太阳公转。

detail.en:
Neptune is an ice giant. It has no hard surface to stand on. Mean radius 24622 km; the displayed diameter is twice that. Its sidereal orbital period is 164.791 Julian years. [S4,S5]

The reference semimajor axis is 30.0699 AU. This is a fitted reference value, not today's Sun distance. The model uses it as a circular radius with uniform angular motion; real orbits are ellipses. All starting phases are a teaching alignment. [S6,S26,S37]

summary.en: Represent many orbiting pieces of ice and rock.
summary.zh: 表示绕土星运动的大量冰块和岩块。

detail.en: Saturn’s rings contain many pieces of ice and rock, not a solid hoop. This thin annulus shows their overall form; its thickness and gaps are illustrative. It shares Saturn’s centre and size mapping. [S11,S37]
detail.zh: 土星环由大量冰块和岩块组成，不是实心圆箍。薄环只表示整体形态，厚度和缝隙是示意。它与土星共用中心和大小映射。[S11,S37]

summary.en: Trace idealised circular paths.
summary.zh: 描出理想化的圆形路径。

detail.en:
These lines are paths, not rods or walls in space. Overview compresses orbital distances using a square-root mapping. True scale and distance views hide these schematic guides. [S37]

Real planetary orbits are ellipses; speeds vary along them. This lesson compares periods without claiming to predict positions on a date. [S26]
detail.zh:
这些线表示路径，不是太空中的杆或墙。总览用平方根映射压缩轨道距离；真比例与距离尺隐藏这些示意线。[S37]

真实行星轨道是椭圆，沿轨道的速率会改变。本主题比较周期，不预测某一天的位置。[S26]

summary.en: Marks reference centres with separate ticks.
summary.zh: 用独立刻线标出参考中心位置。

detail.en:
The line uses a common reference-distance scale: ten scene units per AU. Each tall tick marks a centre position; a tick is not a planet’s diameter. The actual spheres keep the same physical size-to-distance scale and can be too small to see. [S6,S37]

AU is an exactly defined unit; semimajor axes are reference orbit sizes. Earth’s value here is an Earth–Moon barycentre proxy. [S6,S7]
detail.zh:
这条线用同一参考距离尺：每个天文单位对应十个场景单位。竖刻线标出中心位置，不表示行星直径。真正的球体维持统一的大小与距离比例，可能小到看不清。[S6,S37]

天文单位是精确定义的长度；半长轴表示参考轨道大小。这里的地球参数采用地月质心代理值。[S6,S7]

summary.en: Provides a local reference for a moon’s orbit.
summary.zh: 为卫星轨道提供局部参照。

detail.en: A natural satellite orbits a larger body; the pair also travels around the Sun. This local planet and its companion are schematic, not a scale reconstruction of Earth and Moon. [S8,S37]
detail.zh: 自然卫星绕较大的天体运动；两者也一起绕太阳公转。这个母体与伴星是局部示意，不是按比例重建的地月系统。[S8,S37]

summary.en: Orbits its parent while accompanying it around the Sun.
summary.zh: 绕母体运动，同时随母体绕太阳公转。

detail.en:
This companion represents a natural satellite. A moon is not an additional major planet. Mercury and Venus have no moons. The guide marks a local orbit, without reproducing lunar phases or eclipses. [S8]

For Earth’s Moon, use the linked Sun, Earth and Moon lesson. [S37]
detail.zh:
这个伴星表示自然卫星，不是多出的一颗主要行星。水星和金星没有卫星。辅助圈只表示局部轨道，不重画月相或食。[S8]

地球的月球另见链接的《太阳、地球、月亮》。[S37]

summary.en: Represents a small rocky body.
summary.zh: 表示较小的岩质天体。

detail.en: Asteroids are rocky remnants of solar-system formation. This irregular specimen is an original illustrative shape, not a named asteroid or measured surface. Many asteroids orbit in the main belt between Mars and Jupiter. [S9,S37]
detail.zh: 小行星是太阳系形成后留下的岩质天体。这块不规则标本是原创示意形状，不对应某颗有名的小行星或实测表面。许多小行星位于火星与木星之间的主带。[S9,S37]

summary.en: Represents widely separated bodies in the main belt.
summary.zh: 表示主带中分散的天体。

detail.en: Most asteroids are in the main belt between Mars and Jupiter. The marks are a sparse teaching sample, not a count, measured density or wall of touching rocks. Not every asteroid is in this belt. [S9,S37]
detail.zh: 多数小行星位于火星与木星之间的主带。图中只是稀疏的教学标记，不表示数量、实测密度或紧挨着的石墙；并非所有小行星都在主带。[S9,S37]

summary.en: Locates the Sun in the comet experiment.
summary.zh: 标出彗星实验中的太阳。

detail.en: This source marks the Sun at the focus of the illustrative comet ellipse. Sizes and tail lengths are schematic; four eccentric-anomaly steps are not equally spaced times. [S10,S37]
detail.zh: 这个光源标出示意彗星椭圆焦点上的太阳。大小与尾长不按比例；四个偏近点角步骤不代表相等的时间间隔。[S10,S37]

summary.en: Contains ice and dust.
summary.zh: 包含冰与尘埃。

detail.en:
Heating near the Sun can release gas and dust from an icy nucleus, forming a coma and tails. Sunlight and solar wind drive material generally away from the Sun. The narrow ion tail and broader dust tail need not point behind the comet’s motion. [S10]

The four positions and tail lengths are a qualitative construction, not a named comet ephemeris. [S37]
detail.zh:
含冰彗核接近太阳受热时，可能释放气体与尘埃，形成彗发和彗尾。阳光与太阳风使物质大致向背离太阳的方向延伸。细离子尾与较宽的尘尾不一定拖在运动方向后方。[S10]

四个位置和尾长都是定性构图，不是某颗有名彗星的星历。[S37]

summary.en: Marks the cloud around an active nucleus.
summary.zh: 标出活跃彗核周围的云状物。

detail.en:

The four positions and tail lengths are a qualitative construction, not a named comet ephemeris. [S37]

四个位置和尾长都是定性构图，不是某颗有名彗星的星历。[S37]

summary.en: Points generally away from the Sun.
summary.zh: 大致指向背离太阳的方向。

summary.en: Curves alongside the narrow ion tail.
summary.zh: 在细离子尾旁形成弯曲的尾。

detail.en:
Heating near the Sun can release gas and dust from an icy nucleus, forming a coma and tails. Sunlight and solar wind drive material generally away from the Sun. The narrow ion tail and broader dust tail need not point behind the comet’s motion. [S10]

summary.en: Places the meteor example at an atmosphere.
summary.zh: 把流星现象放在大气环境里。

detail.en: This local sphere marks a planet with an atmosphere. A meteor is a light phenomenon during atmospheric passage, not a star falling through space. [S25,S37]
detail.zh: 这个局部球体表示有大气的行星。流星是天体穿过大气时出现的发光现象，不是恒星从太空落下来。[S25,S37]

summary.en: Locates the air around the meteor example.
summary.zh: 标出流星例子中的大气位置。

detail.en: The transparent shell locates an atmosphere; its thickness is enlarged to make it visible. This is not a measured atmospheric-height scale. [S25,S37]
detail.zh: 透明壳标出大气的位置；厚度放大了，便于看见，不是大气高度的测量尺。[S25,S37]

summary.en: Marks light produced during atmospheric passage.
summary.zh: 标出穿过大气时产生的发光现象。

detail.en: A meteor is the luminous phenomenon associated with an incoming meteoroid in an atmosphere. Material that reaches the ground is a meteorite. The drawn streak marks light, not a stellar body or a measured trajectory. [S25,S37]
detail.zh: 流星是流星体进入大气时出现的发光现象。到达地面的物质称为陨石。图中的线表示光迹，不是恒星本体或实测轨迹。[S25,S37]

summary.en: Remains in the solar system as a dwarf planet.
summary.zh: 以矮行星身份留在太阳系中。

detail.en: Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet and remains a solar-system body. It is not one of the eight major planets counted in this lesson. Classification changes a label, not whether the object exists. Size and placement here are schematic. [S4,S37]
detail.zh: 冥王星属于矮行星，仍然是太阳系天体；它不在本主题所数的八颗主要行星之中。分类改变的是名称，不是天体是否存在。这里的大小与位置都是示意。[S4,S37]

summary.en: Exposes an illustrative interior.
summary.zh: 展示示意性的内部。

detail.en: The opening lets us locate the energy-releasing core. Neither this cut surface nor the relative layer thickness is a measurement of the Sun. [S3,S37]
detail.zh: 开口帮助定位释放能量的核心。切口和各层相对厚度都不是太阳的测量数据。[S3,S37]

summary.en: Locates the region where fusion releases energy.
summary.zh: 定位核聚变释放能量的区域。

detail.en: Nuclear fusion in the solar core releases energy. The Sun is hot plasma, not a ball of ordinary burning fuel. This core marker shows location, not a measured core radius. [S3,S37]
detail.zh: 太阳核心的核聚变释放能量。太阳是高温等离子体，不是燃烧普通燃料的火球。核心标记只表示位置，不表示实测半径。[S3,S37]

summary.en: Provides a qualitative comparison light.
summary.zh: 提供定性比较的光源。

detail.en: A distant star appears nearly point-like; a planet’s apparent disc sends light along several atmospheric paths. Averaging those paths usually reduces rapid twinkling. This source shape and sampled brightness are qualitative, not angular-size or weather measurements. [S12,S13,S37]
detail.zh: 遥远恒星看起来近似光点；行星的视圆盘让光经过多条大气路径，不同起伏的平均通常会减弱快速闪烁。光源形状和分步亮度都是定性示意，不是角直径或天气测量。[S12,S13,S37]

summary.en: Provides a qualitative comparison light.
summary.zh: 提供定性比较的光源。

detail.en: A distant star appears nearly point-like; a planet’s apparent disc sends light along several atmospheric paths. Averaging those paths usually reduces rapid twinkling. This source shape and sampled brightness are qualitative, not angular-size or weather measurements. [S12,S13,S37]
detail.zh: 遥远恒星看起来近似光点；行星的视圆盘让光经过多条大气路径，不同起伏的平均通常会减弱快速闪烁。光源形状和分步亮度都是定性示意，不是角直径或天气测量。[S12,S13,S37]

summary.en: Locates changing refractive conditions along the light path.
summary.zh: 标出光路中折射条件会改变的空气。

detail.en: Moving air with changing refractive conditions bends arriving light differently. The translucent planes locate a qualitative atmosphere sample; they are not solid sheets in the sky. Near-horizon paths cross more atmosphere. [S12,S13,S37]
detail.zh: 流动空气中的折射条件会变化，使到来的光发生不同的偏折。半透明平面只标出定性的大气样本，不是天空里的固体薄板。接近地平线的光路会穿过更多大气。[S12,S13,S37]

summary.en: Shows a continuous schematic bent path through air.
summary.zh: 表示光经过空气时连续而偏折的示意路径。

detail.en: The guide shows refraction: changing optical conditions change a light path. The bends are exaggerated to read on a small screen. Use the sampled time control to compare brightness; this line is a qualitative diagram, not a tracked photon. [S12,S37]
detail.zh: 辅助线表示折射：光学条件改变会使光路改变。偏折被放大了，便于在小屏幕上辨认。用分步时间控件比较亮度；线条是定性图，不是对单个光子的追踪。[S12,S37]

summary.en: Shows several continuous paths from an apparent disc.
summary.zh: 表示来自视圆盘的多条连续光路。

detail.en: These four illustrative paths arrive at the same receiving point from different source positions. The model averages independent sampled fluctuations to explain why a planet usually twinkles less than a point-like star. The paths are a static qualitative guide, not measured angular separations or phase-dependent ray tracing. [S13,S37]
detail.zh: 四条示意光路从光源不同位置到达同一接收点。模型对不同路径的分步起伏作平均，解释为什么行星通常比点状恒星闪烁得少。这些线是静态定性辅助线，不是实测角间距或随相位变化的光线追踪。[S13,S37]

summary.en: Shows the corresponding unobstructed reference path.
summary.zh: 表示对应的无遮挡参考光路。

detail.en: Removing the atmospheric sample leaves a straight reference path and constant simulated flux. This isolates the atmospheric cause of the illustrated twinkle; it does not claim all real stars have constant intrinsic brightness. [S12,S37]
detail.zh: 拿掉大气样本后，参考光路变直，模拟通量保持稳定。这个对照分离出图中闪烁的大气成因，并非声称所有真实恒星的内在亮度都不变。[S12,S37]

summary.en: Shows the received relative brightness.
summary.zh: 表示接收到的相对亮度。

detail.en: This receiving point represents the observer’s position. Its glow changes with the calculated received flux, while the source stays steady. It is not a scale model of an eye or telescope. Relative flux uses arbitrary units; changes are qualitative, not weather or stellar-magnitude measurements. [S12,S13,S37]
detail.zh: 这个接收点代表观察位置。它的亮度随计算的接收通量改变，光源本身保持稳定。它不是眼睛或望远镜的比例模型。相对通量使用任意单位，变化只作定性示意，不是天气或恒星星等测量。[S12,S13,S37]

summary.en: Reflects part of the incoming sunlight.
summary.zh: 反射一部分到来的阳光。

detail.en: Planets are visible by reflected sunlight rather than by shining like the Sun. The teaching rays mark an incoming path and a reflected path toward a receiving point. Surface shading is illustrative. [S1,S4,S37]
detail.zh: 行星依靠反射太阳光被看见，不像太阳那样发光。教学光线标出来光与朝接收点去的反射路径。表面明暗是示意。[S1,S4,S37]

summary.en: Links the Sun, a reflecting world and a receiving point.
summary.zh: 把太阳、反光行星与接收点连起来。

detail.en: The two segments illustrate emitted sunlight reaching a planet and some reflected light reaching an observer. Angles, sizes and spacing are layout choices, not a ray-tracing solution. [S1,S37]
detail.zh: 两段线表示太阳发出的光到达行星，以及部分反射光到达观察者。角度、大小与间距只是排版，不是光线追踪解。[S1,S37]

summary.en: Defines the local horizon.
summary.zh: 定义本地地平线。

detail.en:
The observation origin uses latitude 1.3342°N and longitude 103.7357°E as teaching inputs near Singapore’s Science Centre. They are not claimed as an official survey. Hours use Singapore time, UTC+08. The geometric horizon ignores buildings, cloud and sky brightness. [S37]

Science Centre Singapore provides a local astronomy context; actual observing depends on conditions. [S15]
detail.zh:
观察原点采用北纬1.3342度、东经103.7357度作为接近新加坡科学馆的教学输入，不称官方测绘。钟点采用UTC+08的新加坡时间。几何地平线忽略建筑、云和天空亮度。[S37]

科学馆提供本地天文学习背景；实际观测仍受条件影响。[S15]

summary.en: Divides directions above and below the observer.
summary.zh: 划分观察者上方与下方的天空方向。

detail.en: This ring is the local geometric horizon. North is scene −Z, east +X, up +Y. A star plotted above the ring is geometrically above the horizon; it is not guaranteed visible to the eye. [S31,S37]
detail.zh: 这个环表示本地几何地平线：场景负Z为北，正X为东，正Y向上。星点画在环上方，只表示几何上在地平线之上，不保证肉眼能看见。[S31,S37]

summary.en: Locates catalogue directions and their imagined pattern.
summary.zh: 标出星表方向与人画出的图案。

detail.en:
The points come from 28 selected HYG v4.1 catalogue records, kept separately under CC BY-SA 4.0. Fixed J2000 directions are projected through an approximate sidereal-time model. The small aggregate marker is a label anchor, not an extra star. [S28,S30,S31,S34,S37]

Recognition lines are original teaching links, not IAU boundaries or physical connections. They can be switched off. Depth uses historical catalogue distance estimates; missing distances are omitted. [S14,S32,S37]
detail.zh:
星点来自28条HYG v4.1星表记录，单独保留CC BY-SA 4.0许可。固定J2000方向经近似恒星时模型投影。微小的集合标记只承载引线，不是多出来的一颗恒星。[S28,S30,S31,S34,S37]

识别线是原创教学辅助线，不是IAU边界或物理连接，可以关闭。深度对照使用历史星表距离估计，缺值不会当作零距离。[S14,S32,S37]

summary.en: Shows the ground observer belongs to Earth.
summary.zh: 表示地面观察者属于地球。

detail.en: The small external reference sphere locates the observing viewpoint. It does not reproduce the day/night or seasons mechanisms, which are in the linked topic. Compare sky snapshots at different local hours to see apparent motion. [S30,S31,S37]
detail.zh: 这个小球是外部观察位置的参照，不重画链接主题已有的昼夜和季节机制。比较不同本地钟点的天空快照，可以看到视运动。[S30,S31,S37]

summary.en: Compares distance and vacuum light travel time.
summary.zh: 比较距离与真空中的光行时间。

detail.en: The line is a schematic comparator, not a common metric length for all targets. Read the selected distance and vacuum light-time outputs. One light-year is c times one Julian year; light takes about 499 seconds across one AU. [S7,S29,S37]
detail.zh: 线条只作示意比较，不把所有目标画在同一长度尺上。请读所选距离与真空光行时间。光年等于光速乘一个儒略年；光穿过一个天文单位约需499秒。[S7,S29,S37]

summary.en: Marks the nearest star beyond the Sun in the distance comparison.
summary.zh: 在距离对照中标出太阳以外最近的恒星。

detail.en: Proxima Centauri is about 4.24 light-years from the Sun. This large marker gives its position in a schematic comparison; it does not show naked-eye brightness or stellar diameter. It is not the bright Alpha Centauri pair. [S17,S37]
detail.zh: 比邻星距太阳约4.24光年。这个放大的点只在示意比较中标出位置，不表示肉眼亮度或恒星直径，也不是明亮的半人马座α双星。[S17,S37]

summary.en: Places the solar system inside a much larger galaxy.
summary.zh: 把太阳系放进大得多的星系背景中。

detail.en: Our Sun and solar system belong to the Milky Way. This flattened disc with curved bands is a structural reconstruction, not a photograph from outside our galaxy. The bands are representative; do not count them as a measured arm map. The stellar disc is roughly 100,000 light-years across, without a sharp edge. [S16,S24,S35,S37]
detail.zh: 太阳和太阳系属于银河系。扁盘与弯曲带是结构重建，不是从银河系外拍摄的照片。带状结构只是代表性画法，不能数作实测旋臂图。恒星盘直径粗略约十万光年，没有清楚的硬边界。[S16,S24,S35,S37]

summary.en: Marks the central structure of the schematic galaxy.
summary.zh: 标出示意星系的中央结构。

detail.en: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy. The elongated centre marks a bar and central concentration of stars; their relative dimensions here are illustrative. This is not a solid central object or a measured boundary. [S24,S35,S37]
detail.zh: 银河系是棒旋星系。拉长的中心表示中央棒和恒星较集中的区域；相对大小是示意。它不是一个实心中央物体，也不是实测边界。[S24,S35,S37]

summary.en: Identifies a solar-system location within the disc.
summary.zh: 在盘面内标出太阳系的包含关系。

detail.en: This enlarged marker says the solar system lies within the Milky Way. Its placement is schematic, not a precision position or an exact Sun-to-edge distance. We observe the Milky Way from inside it. [S16,S35,S37]
detail.zh: 放大的标记表示太阳系位于银河系之内。位置是示意，不是精确定位，也不给太阳到边缘的距离。我们从银河系内部观测它。[S16,S35,S37]

overview.en: Enlarged bodies; compressed gaps; teaching alignment
overview.zh: 天体放大、间距压缩；教学排列

true-scale.en: One size-and-distance scale; bodies may be invisible
true-scale.zh: 大小与距离统一比例；球体可能看不清

size-row.en: One planet-size scale; gaps are layout
size-row.zh: 行星大小同比例；间隔为排版

distance-ruler.en: One scale; ticks mark positions, not diameters
distance-ruler.zh: 统一比例；刻线标位置，不是直径

schematic.en: Local schematic; no common size-distance scale
schematic.zh: 局部示意；大小与距离不共用比例

sky.en: Fixed J2000 directions; approximate teaching horizon
sky.zh: 固定J2000方向；近似教学地平线
